scope: Read-only targeted audit of latest registered local D1 datasets; this new audit JSON is the only file written.

counts.note: Overlapping chunk windows and per-command samples are not independent grasp demonstrations.

split_checks.scope: Checked source session/segment/log identity, action source-line keys and exact input-image SHA256. No overlapping or adjacent windows from the same source fragment occur across splits. This does not prove unseen-object or independent physical generalization.

fields.q: Seven actual observed SDK positions available before the target command. Order J0 through J6.
fields.actions: Ten future recorded absolute SDK position target commands, shape [10,7], never substituted with actual feedback.
fields.cameras: Global and wrist RGB file paths plus SHA256, camera serials and time alignment metadata.
fields.is_pad: True marks padded target steps that must be excluded from training loss.
fields.actual_target_times: Actual command host-monotonic timestamps, not UTC times.
fields.action_source_lines: Original transport.jsonl line identities for supervised commands.
fields.episode_group: Source-session group used for train/validation isolation; not a claim of complete successful episode.
fields.task_text: Existing examples have no native language-instruction field. Any constant lift instruction added for technical smoke must be explicitly labeled as an adaptation, not evidence of learned language grounding.

record.user_answer: 刚刚我放手了 所以又有接触
record.next_requirement: Establish a verified supported holding/recovery mode before releasing manual support or attempting separation; do not repeat manual lift-and-release or bypass motion/collision guards.

latest_related_historical_collection_sta.interpretation: This is a saved 2026-10-25 observation and direct-user report, not a live hardware check in this audit. It records physical contact after manual support was released and no new action collection.

allowed_evidence_claims: Data loading, tensor/feature mapping, pretrained model inference, finite output and several optimization steps can be tested offline.
Saved and reloaded technical-smoke weights can validate the training code path.
Source-session isolation is present and no checked cross-split frame/command identity overlap was found.
not_supported_claims: No complete grasp training dataset is established by these two lift fragments.
No new-object physical grasp success or language-conditioned capability is demonstrated.
Pretrained SmolVLA action dimensions or normalization cannot be treated as D1-compatible merely because tensor shapes match.
These data do not establish NPU support or acceleration.
full_training_gaps: Continuous successful approach, close, lift, lower/place, release and retreat demonstrations under a consistent action/time contract.
Diverse initial states, locations and object instances, with separate held-out physical instances and fresh evaluation.
D1-specific state/action normalization fitted only on training data; calibrated gripper semantics and robot adapter.
Resolved physical holding/recovery and contact conditions before any newly approved hardware collection.
